name: explore
description: Return the background metadata cache for the active dashboard's worksheets (summary columns + visual specs). Reads whatever is already loaded — instant, no extra API calls.

name: overview-state-ranking
description: Superstore Overview: rank US states and Canadian provinces by Profit Ratio and by Sales, returning the top/bottom 5 for each plus the company headline KPIs.

name: product-peak-months
description: Superstore Product: for each Region, the peak and trough sales month per product category (Furniture / Office Supplies / Technology).

name: customers-top3
description: Superstore Customers: the top 3 customers by sales for every Category x Segment combination, with profit and profit ratio.

name: shipping-delays
description: Superstore Shipping: for each Ship Mode, the order line with the greatest shipping delay (Days to Ship Actual) across the full date history.

name: performance-outliers
description: Superstore Performance: for each year, the category with the biggest overshoot and biggest shortfall vs sales target, plus the sharpest single month/segment/category outlier.

name: commission-plan
description: Superstore Commission Model: at 6/9/12% commission, on-target earnings (OTE) and the top earner's total compensation; and at $400k/$500k/$600k quota, how many reps clear 100% of quota.

name: order-counts
description: Superstore Order Details: distinct order count per state/province — top 10 states by volume plus the total.

name: forecast-scenarios
description: Superstore What If Forecast: total forecast revenue across new-business-growth (12/15/30%) x churn (3/6/9%) scenarios, with uplift vs actuals and the leading region per scenario.

name: daily-executive-summary
description: Executive report across the eight Superstore dashboards: runs overview-state-ranking, product-peak-months, customers-top3, shipping-delays, performance-outliers, commission-plan, order-counts, and forecast-scenarios in one go, then assembles a single HTML summary.
